status: Approved target design including file-origin amendment on 2026-10-19; independent technical review PASS; not implemented

tables.name: ticket_drafts
tables.grain: One draft identity, retained after sending or discarding; at most one active draft per ticket.

fields.name: id
fields.rules: PK; required; application-generated UUIDv7; no SQL default
fields.meaning_source: Identity generated at creation; never reused.
fields.reader: all draft operations and retry lookup

fields.name: workspace_id
fields.rules: required; FK workspaces ON DELETE CASCADE
fields.meaning_source: Principal workspace; never supplied by client.

fields.name: ticket_id
fields.rules: required; composite FK (workspace_id,ticket_id) to tickets(workspace_id,id) ON DELETE CASCADE
fields.meaning_source: Visible email ticket supplied by caller.

fields.name: creation_key
fields.meaning_source: Caller request_id; browser generates a stable UUID for initial save.

fields.name: creation_hash
fields.meaning_source: Domain-separated HMAC of canonical original create input, including ordered attachment IDs.
fields.reader: same-key/different-input detection; not derived from mutable draft

fields.name: hash_version
fields.meaning_source: Canonicalization/HMAC format version.

fields.name: state
fields.meaning_source: Active draft, consumed outgoing message, or explicitly discarded draft.
fields.reader: active lookup and terminal retry protection

fields.name: revision
fields.meaning_source: Server version incremented on each edit or terminal transition.

fields.name: body_html
fields.meaning_source: Sanitized caller HTML; MCP markdown converts before validation. Templates stay unfilled until explicit send.
fields.reader: editor, preview and normal reply rendering

fields.name: mailbox_id
fields.rules: nullable; FK mailboxes ON DELETE SET NULL; default NULL
fields.meaning_source: Selected sending mailbox; NULL inherits the current ticket mailbox. Workspace/brand/send checks apply.

fields.name: cc_emails
fields.meaning_source: Validated, normalized caller Cc list; order preserved.

fields.name: bcc_emails
fields.meaning_source: Validated, normalized caller Bcc list; order preserved.

fields.name: created_by_type
fields.meaning_source: Principal kind at creation, preserved if its referenced principal is deleted.

fields.name: created_by_user_id
fields.rules: nullable; FK users ON DELETE SET NULL
fields.meaning_source: Authenticated user for browser/OAuth creation, otherwise NULL.

fields.name: created_by_api_key_id
fields.rules: nullable; FK api_keys ON DELETE SET NULL
fields.meaning_source: API key for key-authenticated creation, otherwise NULL.

fields.name: updated_by_type
fields.meaning_source: Principal kind of the latest edit or terminal action.

fields.name: updated_by_user_id
fields.rules: nullable; FK users ON DELETE SET NULL
fields.meaning_source: Latest authenticated user actor, otherwise NULL.

fields.name: updated_by_api_key_id
fields.rules: nullable; FK api_keys ON DELETE SET NULL
fields.meaning_source: Latest API key actor, otherwise NULL.

fields.name: message_id
fields.rules: nullable; FK messages ON DELETE SET NULL; default NULL
fields.meaning_source: Committed outgoing message for state=sent; NULL before send or if the message was physically purged.

fields.name: created_at
fields.meaning_source: Server creation time in UTC.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.meaning_source: Server time of latest successful mutation.

fields.name: ended_at
fields.rules: nullable; default NULL; NULL iff state=draft
fields.meaning_source: Server time of send acceptance or discard, not provider delivery time.

constraints: Partial UNIQUE(workspace_id,ticket_id) WHERE state='draft' permits only one active shared draft.
Actor kind rejects a non-NULL reference of the other kind; deletion can leave both principal references NULL.
Only state=sent may have a non-NULL message_id. A sent row with a deleted message remains terminal.
tables.lifecycle: No automatic expiration. Terminal identities remain with the ticket; physical ticket/workspace deletion cascades. Send/discard clears body, Cc/Bcc and mailbox selection and removes active attachment reservations; keep identity, original hash, attribution and committed message result.

tables.name: ticket_draft_attachments
tables.grain: One currently reserved file in one active draft.

fields.name: workspace_id
fields.meaning_source: Principal workspace, copied from the locked draft.

fields.name: draft_id
fields.rules: required; composite FK (workspace_id,draft_id) to ticket_drafts(workspace_id,id) ON DELETE CASCADE
fields.meaning_source: The active draft reserving the file.
fields.reader: draft reads, access and cleanup exclusion

fields.name: attachment_id
fields.rules: required; composite FK (workspace_id,attachment_id) to attachments(workspace_id,id) ON DELETE CASCADE
fields.meaning_source: Validated fresh upload or existing reservation on this draft.
fields.reader: normal stored bytes and final message attachment

fields.name: position
fields.meaning_source: Zero-based position in caller attachment_ids, without duplicates.

constraints: UNIQUE(attachment_id) reserves a file for at most one active draft.
Membership changes lock the draft and attachment rows. Ordinary message linking excludes reserved uploads.
tables.lifecycle: Remove reservation on removal, discard or committed send. Existing cleanup handles genuinely unattached/unreserved files after its existing threshold.

tables.name: ticket_preparations
tables.grain: One durable creation reference in a workspace and caller-chosen namespace.

fields.name: workspace_id
fields.rules: required; FK workspaces ON DELETE CASCADE
fields.meaning_source: Workspace from principal.

fields.name: namespace
fields.meaning_source: Stable integration namespace from preparation.namespace, for example weekly-orders.
fields.reader: reference uniqueness across key rotations and API/MCP callers

fields.name: reference
fields.meaning_source: Stable caller order/creation identifier from preparation.reference; case-sensitive.

fields.name: request_hash
fields.meaning_source: Domain-separated HMAC of canonical original ticket-creation input; excludes the preparation identity itself.
fields.reader: detect changed original input without comparing agent-edited content

fields.name: hash_version
fields.meaning_source: Version of normalization and hashing.

fields.name: ticket_id
fields.rules: nullable; FK tickets ON DELETE SET NULL
fields.meaning_source: Created ticket, set before creation transaction commits; NULL means physically deleted result. Writes verify the same workspace.
fields.writer: create; merge redirects to surviving ticket
fields.reader: repeat creation result and preparation guard

fields.name: created_at
fields.meaning_source: Server time of first creation.

fields.name: released_at
fields.meaning_source: First explicit outgoing send releases preparation protection; discard or status change does not release it.

constraints: Partial INDEX(workspace_id,ticket_id) WHERE released_at IS NULL AND ticket_id IS NOT NULL.
Reference ownership is the workspace, not a particular API key. Every result lookup rechecks current ticket visibility.
tables.lifecycle: Retain until workspace deletion, including after 24-hour HTTP replay expiry. A NULL ticket result is a tombstone and returns 410; never recreate it automatically.

existing_changes.change: Add UNIQUE(workspace_id,id) as a target for the draft composite FK; no new columns or response fields.
existing_changes.used: id uuid PK default gen_random_uuid(); workspace_id uuid NOT NULL FK workspaces CASCADE; number bigint NOT NULL; subject text NOT NULL default ''; channel text NOT NULL CHECK email/chat/api/portal; status text NOT NULL default open CHECK open/pending/on_hold/solved/closed; contact_id/mailbox_id/assignee_id/team_id nullable UUID FKs SET NULL; brand_id uuid NOT NULL FK brands RESTRICT; received_at text NOT NULL default ''; deleted_at timestamptz nullable; merged_into_id uuid nullable FK tickets SET NULL. number and received_at supply subject/thread/alias context.
existing_changes.impact: Existing JSON shape/defaults stay unchanged; preparation protection is derived from ticket_preparations.

existing_changes.change: Add draft_ticket_id uuid NULL for durable unsent-file provenance, UNIQUE(workspace_id,id) for reservations, and an index on (workspace_id,draft_ticket_id) WHERE draft_ticket_id IS NOT NULL.
existing_changes.used: id uuid PK default gen_random_uuid(); workspace_id uuid NOT NULL FK workspaces CASCADE; message_id uuid nullable FK messages CASCADE; filename text NOT NULL (no default); content_type text NOT NULL default application/octet-stream; storage_key text NOT NULL (no default); size_bytes bigint NOT NULL (no default); inline boolean NOT NULL default false; uploaded_by/uploaded_by_api_key_id/uploaded_by_contact_id nullable UUID FKs SET NULL; created_at timestamptz NOT NULL default now(). Added draft_ticket_id uuid nullable default NULL, composite FK (workspace_id,draft_ticket_id) to tickets(workspace_id,id) ON DELETE CASCADE.
existing_changes.impact: Draft association writes the origin from the visible ticket. Removal/discard retains it; cleanup still uses active reservations. Current origin visibility is required before any signed-link branch; stream these files with no-store and no new storage redirect. Normal message linking clears origin atomically and takes over file access.

existing_changes.change: Add recipient_locked boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, written true only for reviewed draft sends. Existing creation/linking adds a narrow authorization path for reserved draft files.
existing_changes.used: id uuid PK default gen_random_uuid(); workspace_id uuid NOT NULL FK workspaces CASCADE; ticket_id uuid NOT NULL FK tickets CASCADE; kind text NOT NULL CHECK reply/note; direction text NOT NULL CHECK inbound/outbound; body_html/body_text/subject/from_email/from_name text NOT NULL default ''; to_emails/cc_emails/bcc_emails text[] NOT NULL default '{}'; mailbox_id uuid nullable FK mailboxes SET NULL; author_user_id uuid nullable FK users SET NULL; reply_to text NOT NULL default ''; auth_failed boolean NOT NULL default false; delivery_status text NOT NULL default none CHECK none/pending/sent/failed/bounced; delivery_error text NOT NULL default ''; created_at timestamptz NOT NULL default now(). Proposed recipient_locked boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false (internal, not JSON). reply_to/from_email/auth_failed and latest created_at select the current validated Reply-To; author_user_id selects normal sender attribution.
existing_changes.impact: domain.AddMessage remains the creation boundary. Reviewed recipients are stored once; the worker skips late Reply-To re-resolution when recipient_locked=true. Existing immediate sends keep false and preserve their behavior.

existing_changes.change: No schema change; reuse current workspace-scoped recipient and sending-address resolution.
existing_changes.used: contacts.id uuid PK default gen_random_uuid(), workspace_id uuid NOT NULL FK workspaces CASCADE, email citext nullable, name text NOT NULL default '', blocked boolean NOT NULL default false. mailboxes.id uuid PK default gen_random_uuid(), workspace_id uuid NOT NULL FK workspaces CASCADE, name text NOT NULL, email citext NOT NULL, display_name text NOT NULL default '', status text NOT NULL default active CHECK active/error/disabled, team_id uuid nullable FK teams SET NULL, brand_id uuid NOT NULL FK brands RESTRICT, inbound_kind text NOT NULL CHECK forwarding/imap/google/microsoft, outbound_kind text NOT NULL CHECK smtp/google/microsoft/system, forwarding_token text NOT NULL UNIQUE, aliases text[] NOT NULL default '{}', from_name_format text NOT NULL default '{agent} at {mailbox}'. These select contact eligibility, sender name/address, alias, capability and private sending permission; no credentials are projected. mailboxes.created_at timestamptz NOT NULL default now() orders the existing oldest eligible mailbox fallback.
existing_changes.impact: Preview and send resolve the same current contact, latest Reply-To and mailbox rules; credentials stay server-side.

existing_changes.change: No schema or TTL change. Bypass response caching for draft POSTs, preparation-enabled ticket creation and the outer /mcp envelope before serving a cached response.
existing_changes.used: id uuid PK default gen_random_uuid(); workspace_id uuid nullable FK workspaces CASCADE; user_id uuid nullable FK users CASCADE; api_key_id uuid nullable FK api_keys CASCADE; CHECK exactly one of user_id/api_key_id non-null; key text NOT NULL length 1..255; method/path text NOT NULL; request_hash bytea NOT NULL; status integer nullable; content_type/location text NOT NULL default ''; body_enc bytea nullable; created_at timestamptz NOT NULL default now(); completed_at timestamptz nullable. Unique normalized workspace/principal/key expression index; created_at cleanup index. Cached status/content_type/location/body_enc represent a completed legacy transport response.
existing_changes.impact: Every feature retry executes current handler authorization and resolves its durable identity. Legacy inner API writes retain existing replay behavior. Outer /mcp bypass runs before its 32 MiB hashing bound; MCP itself enforces 36 MiB.

existing_changes.change: Schema unchanged. New addressing helper projects only these non-secret identity/name inputs; template variable/signature loading remains inside the unchanged templates module.
existing_changes.used: users.id uuid PK default gen_random_uuid(), users.name text NOT NULL default ''; teams.id uuid PK default gen_random_uuid(), teams.workspace_id uuid NOT NULL FK workspaces CASCADE, teams.name text NOT NULL, teams.private boolean NOT NULL default false; brands.id uuid PK default gen_random_uuid(), brands.workspace_id uuid NOT NULL FK workspaces CASCADE, brands.name text NOT NULL. Sender formatting uses the reviewing user name and ticket team/brand names; teams.private selects existing visibility rules.
existing_changes.impact: Preserve the current sender naming and private-team rules. No password, token or connection secret is copied into preview/draft data.

existing_changes.used: team_members.team_id/user_id uuid NOT NULL FKs teams/users CASCADE, composite PK(team_id,user_id); api_keys.id uuid PK default gen_random_uuid(), workspace_id uuid NOT NULL FK workspaces CASCADE, scopes text[] NOT NULL default '{}', private_team_ids uuid[] NOT NULL default '{}'. Membership/key grants control private visibility; scopes control available operations. Role resolution remains the existing auth boundary.
existing_changes.impact: Read current membership/grants per request, including all durable feature retries and draft-origin file fetches.
